verdict.rationale: Evidence only vaguely gestures at reporting ('flow performance reports', 'pull data...to keep up with marketing performance', '63x avg ROI') but never documents a concrete revenue/signup attribution model tied to specific emails or flows beyond opens/clicks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-campaign/per-flow revenue attribution, signup attribution, or conversion tracking metrics distinct from opens/clicks, and any independent corroboration of attribution accuracy.
